# GitHub Copilot — repository instructions

The canonical, tool-agnostic context for this repository lives in
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Read it first.

Key entry points:

- [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) — project overview, layout, commands, conventions
- [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](../ARCHITECTURE.md) — system architecture
- [`CONTEXT-MAP.md`](../CONTEXT-MAP.md) — project map + glossary
- [`.cursor/BUGBOT.md`](../.cursor/BUGBOT.md) — recurring bug patterns to avoid

Each package has its own `AGENTS.md` with package-specific context. Authoring
conventions are encoded as skills under `.agents/skills/`.
